descriptive_title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Numbers — Mental Math and Algorithms to 1000, Multiplication and Division to 10×10, Fractions as Repeated Addition, and Ratios 1:2 / 1:5 / 1:10 (B2.1–B2.9)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Grade-3 unit on operations (B2.1-B2.9) framed around 'The Times Table Toolkit' — Tony, Maya, and Pixel. Mental math, algorithms, multiplication facts to 10×10, fractions as repeated addition, and ratios all in one focused week.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Times Table Toolkit Operators. Day 1 covers mental math and the standard algorithm for sums and differences to 1000 (B2.3, B2.4, B2.5). Day 2 anchors the ×2, ×5, ×10 multiplication facts and related divisions with arrays and fact triangles (B2.2, B2.1). Day 3 extends to all multiplication facts up to 10×10 with the distributive property (B2.6). Day 4 connects fractions to multiplication: 3/4 = 3 × 1/4, and 4 × 1/2 = 2 wholes (B2.8, B2.7). Day 5 closes with ratios 1:2, 1:5, 1:10 in real-world contexts (B2.9). Each lesson includes a 4000+ char expanded_walkthrough covering misconceptions and recovery moves.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson

13 printable teacher manipulatives plus 3 character puppets: base-ten blocks label (with thousand-cubes), double ten-frame mat, multiplication chart 1-10, array grid mat, two-colour counters label, 30 fact-family triangles for ×2/×5/×10, 8 fraction strips per pair, ratio table template, 18 story problem cards, the Times Table Toolkit anchor poster, plus stick-puppet variants of Tony, Maya, and Pixel
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 nine-row summative rubric covering B2.1-B2.9 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 worksheet
Junior Times Table Toolkit Operator certificate (one per child)
Detailed expanded walkthroughs covering: silent-regroup error, multiplication-division separation, all-or-nothing recall, unit-fraction-collapse, additive scale-up
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 3 teachers covering the B2.1-B2.9 cluster — the densest Number-strand cluster of Grade 3.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: CRA progression. Real base-ten blocks, two-colour counters, fraction strips, and ratio tables anchor every concept. Lesson 1 covers operational fluency to 1000. Lesson 2 builds gateway fact recall. Lesson 3 extends to all multiplication via distributive property. Lesson 4 connects fractions to multiplication. Lesson 5 reveals ratios as scaling. Differentiation is proactive.
